# pve_node_services (Data Source)

Lists the systemd services PVE manages on one node (`GET /nodes/{node}/services`), with their current systemd states. Fields a service does not report are empty.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Systemd services managed by PVE on node pve1, with their current states.
data "pve_node_services" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "pve1_service_states" {
  value = { for svc in data.pve_node_services.pve1.services : svc.name => svc.state }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node whose services to list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source (the node name).
- `services` (Attributes List) Services managed by PVE on the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `active_state` (String) Current state of the service process (systemd ActiveState). One of: `active`, `inactive`, `failed`, `activating`, `deactivating`, `maintenance`, `reloading`, `refreshing`, `unknown`.
- `description` (String) Description of the service.
- `name` (String) Short identifier for the service (e.g. `pveproxy`).
- `service` (String) Systemd unit name (e.g. `pveproxy`).
- `state` (String) Execution status of the service process (systemd SubState), e.g. `running`, `dead`, `exited`, `failed`.
- `unit_state` (String) Whether the service is enabled (systemd UnitFileState), e.g. `enabled`, `disabled`, `static`, `masked`.
